note: The RTMLink app commit on `main` (production, live at rtmlink.com) that the help center has been TRIAGED up to. In the three-agent pipeline the Scout (meta/agents/scout.md) advances this in its triage PR, after diffing `main` forward from here and flagging affected articles — it means 'every change up to here has been triaged into the registry as stale/todo', NOT 'every article is reconciled'. Per-article reconciliation is tracked separately by each article's `last_reviewed_commit`, which the Writer advances. ALWAYS diff from origin/main, never `git rev-parse HEAD` (the app working tree is often an unmerged feature branch). Advance this only to a merged `main` commit, together with that window's flags.
